in_marathi.name: Dayananda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of Bliss
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dayananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dayananda is derived from the Sanskrit words 'daya' which means 'compassion' and 'ananda' which means 'bliss'. It is a name given to those who are believed to bestow happiness and compassion upon others. This name has a rich cultural history and is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology.
